briefs.rationale: The rewritten brief keeps the ordinal, combinatorial, descriptive-set-theoretic, proof-theoretic, PCF and reflection strands and adds the three gained pages: large cardinals from inaccessibility and Mahloness through weak compactness and measurability to strong compactness and supercompactness, developed via ultrafilters, ultrapowers, normal and fine measures and covering embeddings; the constructible hierarchy and HOD as inner models with a definable well-order; and forcing through dense sets, generics, check names and Boolean-valued semantics.

The rewritten brief integrates the two gained Fourier pages into the operator-theoretic spine: the L-one transform with convolution-to-product, Gaussian kernels, inversion and finite-measure uniqueness, then Schwartz space with its seminorm topology, Parseval pairing, the unitary Plancherel extension and Poisson summation. It also removes the now-stale final-page claim by recording that the part ends with locally convex spaces, gauges and continuous separation under Hahn-Banach, keeping the DC and AC-omega choice boundaries of the Baire and uniform-boundedness arguments.

The rewritten brief adds the gained weak-mixing page: its three equivalent descriptions (vanishing Cesaro correlations, product ergodicity, absence of nonconstant eigenfunctions) proved through orthogonal projections and compact intertwiners, and the three-cut, one-spacer Chacon transformation, which is ergodic and weakly mixing but not strongly mixing. The measure, L-p, Riesz-Thorin interpolation, differentiation and representation strands of the existing section are retained.
